title: Maximum Subarray
description:
Select a contiguous, nonempty slice of nums and return the greatest possible sum of its elements. A slice must contain at least one value, so an all-negative array has a negative answer.

The best slice may begin after a poor prefix; you do not need to return its indices.

Example 1

Input: nums = [-2,1,-3,4,-1,2,1,-5,4]
Output: 6

Explanation: The slice [4,-1,2,1] sums to 6.

Example 2

Input: nums = [1]
Output: 1

Explanation: The only nonempty slice has sum 1.

Example 3

Input: nums = [-3,-2,-5]
Output: -2

Explanation: The single value -2 is better than any longer slice.

Constraints

  • 1 ≤ nums.length ≤ 10,000.
  • -10,000 ≤ nums[i] ≤ 10,000.

exampleTestCases.explanation: The only nonempty slice has sum 1.
The single value -2 is better than any longer slice.

inputs: gen:[1 if i % 2 == 0 else -1 for i in range(100000)]
